# `btn`

Helper: `btn(text, variant, o)`, `primary secondary quiet danger lnk light back iconBtn`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `Button` (`button.tsx`) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaPrimary` (core:ui), `PemaOutlinedButton` (core:ui), `PemaTextButton` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Optional leading icon, label, optional trailing icon. Icon-only button has an accessible name (`aria`).

## Variants

- primary
- secondary
- danger (outlined)
- dangers (solid)
- quiet (text, link colour)
- link
- light (on a hero)
- size `sm`, `full` width, icon-only

## States

- Default
- Hover: primary darkens to brand-600, secondary fills tile, danger fills danger-soft, quiet underlines (kit)
- Focus: focus ring
- Disabled: 50% opacity, no pointer

## Tokens

brand-500, brand-600, surface, line-strong, ink, danger, danger-line, link, brand-50 (light), radius-control, text-small

## Do

- One primary per view or dialog footer, on the right
- Label is the action ("Lưu", not "OK")

## Don't

- Do not use two primaries together
- Do not use danger for a harmless action

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Height 40 (sm 32), padding 0 14, radius 10.

## Mobile (390)

Height 44 (sm 36); long labels wrap and centre.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Inline. Variants `primary secondary danger dangers quiet link light`; `light` = pale button on a dark hero, `back('← Trang chủ')` = the Patient Mobile back link
